suite: leaders across the seam (synthetic anchors, the lit set, the selection triple, P2)

mutations.contract: A dot scrolled out of the DAG's view has no leader.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff leaders_follow_the_active_study_across_the_seam (2026-10-27). Draws one to every dot, in view or not.

dotClip: { left: p.left, right: p.right,

                   ? head.getBoundingClientRect().bottom : p.top, 0),
